notes.title: AURELIA 1.0.1 IS HERE! SPANISH HAS ARRIVED!
notes.content:
[h2]Thanks everyone for supporting and playing Aurelia. The first patch is here! [/h2]

Here are the patch notes:

- Added Spanish (Spain) and Spanish (LATAM)
- Solved some display issues in the Journal that would show hints even if the questline was completed.
- Reworked the display of “Item Lore” in the inventory to allow even the longest descriptions to fit in the box.
- Fixed the achievement "Honoring our Royalty" triggering multiple times.
- Fixed the achievement “Drinking Buddies” triggering multiple times.
- Blackjack achievements should now be unlockable on Steam.
- The game will now check for in-game achievements when entering the Achievements submenu and unlock any achievement your save has that Steam doesn’t.
- Fixed “Shiny Blessing” achievement not unlocking in some instances.
- Improved the font display for Russian.
- Eliminated the "Patch notes button" as it was creating other unintended side effects. Patch notes will be now be hosted on appropriate platform.
- Disabled the “Bug Report” feature, as it was causing unintentional side effects. Pressing the button will still unlock the related achievement.
- Bar minigame will no longer “slowly drain HP”, missing clients will instead lose 15 HP.
- Exorcised Scarlet so she doesn't appear levitating at night in Ivy's room.
- Nerfed Ivy's speed so she can't be on two rooms at once.
- Scarlet “[Firewood]” option will not appear until quest conditions have been met.
- Changed Karos Dialogue so he doesn't ask for wood anymore.
- Fixed instances where the Audio could load from an older save to a value over 100%
- Fixed an issue where the “Catch bar” in the fishing minigame could go out of bounds.

If you need bug support, have feedback, or want to hang with others of culture,[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/aureliagame/] stop by r/aureliagame[/url] or [url=https://discord.gg/twzMbu8]visit the official Discord.[/url]

Ciao for now!
